faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, appointments, and facilities.
faqPage.contactDescription: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please contact our friendly team.
faq.general.a1: Our hospital operates 24/7 for emergency services. OPD timings are from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. Sunday OPD is available from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
faq.general.q2: How do I book an appointment?
faq.general.a2: You can book an appointment through our website or by calling our helpline at +91 9771447716. Walk-in appointments are also available based on doctor availability.
faq.general.a3: Yes, we accept most major health insurance providers including Star Health, ICICI Lombard, Max Bupa, HDFC Ergo, and many more. Please contact our billing department for the complete list.
faq.general.a4: Shri Durga Hospital is located at Thana Road, Kanti, Ward No-17, Muzaffarpur-843109, Bihar. We have parking facilities available for patients.
faq.appointments.a1: Yes, you can reschedule your appointment up to 4 hours before the scheduled time. You can do this through our patient portal, mobile app, or by calling our helpline.
faq.appointments.q2: What documents do I need to bring?
faq.appointments.a2: Please bring a valid photo ID, insurance card (if applicable), any previous medical records, and a list of current medications. First-time patients should arrive 15 minutes early for registration.
faq.appointments.q3: How long is the typical wait time?
faq.appointments.a3: We strive to minimize wait times. For scheduled appointments, the average wait time is 15-20 minutes. Emergency cases are prioritized based on severity.
faq.billing.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.billing.a1: We accept cash, credit/debit cards, UPI payments, net banking, and all major insurance providers. EMI options are also available for larger bills.
faq.billing.q2: How do I get a detailed bill?
faq.billing.a2: Detailed bills are provided at discharge. You can also access your billing history through our patient portal or request a copy from our billing department.
faq.billing.a3: Yes, cashless treatment is available for patients with insurance from our empaneled providers. Please check with our TPA desk before admission.
faq.emergency.q1: How do I access emergency services?
faq.emergency.a1: Our emergency department is open 24/7. Call 9771447716 for emergency services or visit our emergency entrance directly.
faq.emergency.q2: Do you have an ambulance service?
faq.emergency.a2: Yes, we have ambulance service available. Call 9771447716 for immediate assistance.
faq.emergency.q3: What emergency facilities do you have?
faq.emergency.a3: Our emergency department includes a trauma center, cardiac emergency unit, stroke unit, and pediatric emergency. We have 24/7 specialists on call for all major specialties.
faq.patientCare.a1: Yes, one attendant is allowed to stay with the patient overnight in private and semi-private rooms. General ward patients can have visitors during visiting hours only.
faq.patientCare.a2: General visiting hours are 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM daily. ICU visiting is limited to 30 minutes, twice daily at 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.
faq.patientCare.a3: Yes, we offer comprehensive post-discharge support including follow-up appointments, home healthcare services, physiotherapy, and 24/7 teleconsultation.
